title: Computer with components
description: Create Computadora with composition: CPU and RAM as internal objects.
hints: Computadora creates CPU and RAM in its constructor
solutionExplanation: Composition: Computadora creates and owns the CPU and RAM.
expectedOutput:
Computer: Dell
CPU: Intel i7 @3.6GHz
RAM: 16GB

title: Order with Products
description: Create Pedido and Producto. The order uses existing products (aggregation).
solutionExplanation: Aggregation: Pedido uses references to Producto objects.

title: Hospital with mixed relationship
description: Create Hospital (composition with Consulta) and Doctor (aggregation with Hospital).
solutionExplanation: A mix of composition and aggregation.
expectedOutput:
Dr. Perez attends to Ana
Dr. Perez attends to Luis
Hospital: Hospital Central
Appointment: Ana - Dolor de pecho
Appointment: Luis - Check-up
